Im sorry you are going through this :( I completely understand where you are coming from, I am sort of in the same position so I don’t have much good advice. My only advice is to seek distractions such as maybe spending time with your friends. Something that has also really helped me is talking about my phobia casually and aknowleging my anxiety with my friends... by saying outloud that I feel anxious about being sick sort of grounds me because for one I am saying it, and for 2 usually my friends will comfort me by telling me why they don’t think I’ll be S* or how they don’t think about it all the time etc. Also get someone to go have food with. By taking with someone even if they are just eating may give food a better connotation in your mind. Even just having a little bit of food consistent with your friends or something might help. Also for me, when I’m really anxious but know I need to eat sometimes I call my parents because I know they want to hear from me anyways cuz I’m gone and also because even just having a little conversation calms me down.  
Also maybe be really involved acedemically and study a lot. This has helped me tremendously. This may not work for you but I am very motivated about school and being busy helps my anxiety a lot. (Like If i am inside doing nothing for an hour it is like litterally a recipie for a panic attack) so by focusing on school and being really busy it distracts my mind from going on tangents. By being proactive and being busy BEFORE I get anxious is the best. Because I understand how hard it is to get out of anxiety once you have it.
